name: Can I include an ADU or garage conversion in my whole-house renovation plan?

mainEntity.name: Can I include an ADU or garage conversion in my whole-house renovation plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding an ADU or converting a garage should be evaluated as a distinct scope within the broader renovation because it can affect zoning, utilities, access, fire and life-safety review, parking considerations, and construction sequencing. Feasibility depends on the property and jurisdiction, so do not assume that available floor area automatically makes the project approvable. Elite Remodeling & Design offers ADUs and garage conversions as part of its residential services. Request a feasibility review before committing to finishes or combining the work with the main house.
acceptedAnswer.description: Possibly, but an ADU or garage conversion should receive its own feasibility review because it may affect zoning, utilities, access, safety review, parking, and sequencing. Elite Remodeling & Design offers both services; ask whether the property, intended use, and proposed layout support the concept before finalizing the larger renovation.
